entries.title: Usage no longer opens with a coverage notice
entries.body: Settings → Usage goes straight from Period and Work to its totals. The panel above them that explained recorded models, estimates and token coverage is gone; the totals, a model's details and the recent tasks still say when they leave something out.
entries.noPicture: What changed is a panel that is no longer there, so there is nothing new to show.

entries.title: Long Settings tabs keep space at the bottom
entries.body: A Settings tab taller than the window, such as General or Usage, now ends with the same space below its last row as a shorter tab, rather than stopping at the window's edge.
entries.noPicture: A small spacing fix at the end of a scrolled tab; a release review takes a picture if this becomes a highlight.
